title: $1,000 in Walmart in 1990 is now worth this
caption:
In 1990, Walmart was a discount store.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:WMT:1990-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Walmart in 1990? 👇
sources: Walmart price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 1990, Walmart was a discount store.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:WMT:1990-01-02}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
